title: OSMOSE-EEC factorial plan simulation for offshore wind farm cumulative impact assessment
description: This repository contains all necessary configuration files, input data, simulation scripts, and post-processing routines to run the OSMOSE-EEC model under a factorial design assessing the cumulative impact of offshore wind farm development, fishing regulation, and climate change scenarios on the Eastern English Channel ecosystem.
